purpose: Persist parameter-independent prepared SIDIS/SIA contexts for later Julia-owned evaluation and recovery. This component cannot admit a physical prediction, likelihood, fit or production job.
contents: Fixed grids, source bases/logarithms, detached matching rows, quadrature/CSS arrays, fixed unpolarized denominator, target/charge and provenance metadata. No fitted parameter vector, prediction, gradient, HVP, optimization state, replica or native/provider handle.

format.encoding: Bounded JSON with an explicit whitelisted typed object table plus one native-endian primitive-array payload. Preserve full Float64 bits, scalar types, dimensions and repeated row-object aliases. No eval, executable serialization, pickle or arbitrary type lookup.
format.platform: Require matching Julia version, 64-bit integer layout and explicit native-endian marker. Cross-version or cross-endian conversion is not implemented.
format.completion: Use a fresh destination. Hash and validate the complete payload before publishing the final manifest; partial files have no accepted receipt. Preserve failed writes.
format.reader: Require an out-of-band expected manifest SHA256 and the exact expected bindings/input kind. Verify manifest, payload, all array spans/types/dimensions, alias references, reconstructed component signatures and complete logical fixed-data identity. Load owned read-only row storage; public mutation guards remain active.

input_kind: The caller must explicitly select analytic or pinned_inputs; both initial sample legs must match. Analytic/synthetic storage evidence cannot be read as pinned physical input.
preservation: Keep all signs, masses/z factors, Fourier measures, matching/evolution, range continuation, cuts, angular definitions, targets, data/error fields, likelihoods, bounds and numerical acceptance policies unchanged. The existing full132 frozen job policy continues to prohibit new query caches; this isolated component is not inserted into those running jobs.
loop_ownership: Julia writes and reads numerical contexts and owns all predictions/derivatives/optimization. Python/Snakemake schedules only complete jobs. Load/reuse fixed contexts within Julia; never call a model or a Python callback inside numerical evaluation.

validation.software: Linux Python tests, workflow-plan validation, complete Julia tests and Snakemake closure/cache remain required after implementation. Small analytic fixtures are explicitly synthetic.
validation.roundtrip: Require identical fixed-data signatures, every array bit, row-alias structure, owned-row mutation behavior and bitwise identical Float64 values, all13 gradients and directional HVPs before/after reload. Preserve the SIA first-six zero columns and target/charge composition.
validation.counterfactuals: Reject changed/truncated payload, changed manifest, wrong external digest or bindings, mismatched input kind/version/endian, unsupported types, nonfinite data, invalid/overlapping array spans, dimensions, missing objects, broken aliases and production claims. Preserve each original failed attempt.
validation.physical_case_selection: Use freshly source-bound requests for the same pinned historical rows and literal published13 parameters. SIDIS covers HERMES proton, COMPASS proton and free-isoscalar deuteron; SIA covers source hadron2 UL/UC composition. These four storage roundtrips are not all132 or all72 scientific validation.
validation.resources: Keep cold preparation, writing, verification, loading and warm evaluation timings separate. Record whole-command resources and interruptions; unavailable prerequisites remain unaccepted. No production throughput, full-fit ETA, parameter-domain accuracy or G2PERF claim follows.

limitations: The original interrupted diagnostic attempts remain incomplete and cannot authorize replacement attempts.
Source covariance/overlap, author-code and unrounded-state limitations and existing scientific benchmark failures remain unresolved.
Storage identity is not independent evolution or derivative-accuracy validation, parameter-domain closure or uncertainty coverage.
No STAR context, bounded-fit execution, data admission or parameter-response cache is implemented by this format.
B0 historical262, B1 updated SIDIS/SIA, B2/B3 STAR200/510, B4 paired full-x lattice, V1 robustness, uncertainty and publication all remain required.
